holdings.note: Pretend balance for a pretend wallet. In-world the claim is confirmable on-chain at the identity anchor; no keys exist because none are needed.

intents.story: Priscilla manages a savings-and-loan branch and thinks in buckets and calendar years: the offer is open through December 31 for a January 1 start, the way renewal season works at the branch. Most of her holdings sit in cold storage she considers out of scope; she wants only the spending money covered, and under-insuring this wallet is deliberate, not a mistake.
